answer: When agents forge transactions, the network maps payment flows into a trust ledger. If ten identities draw from one vault or submit bids in ivory-tower synchrony, the system collapses them into a single reputation score. An attacker spawning a hundred puppets gains no leverage because shared funding patterns brand them as one entity. Splitting funds across wallets costs real capital and time, raising the economic ledge an adversary must scale to fake independent histories.
